 OLIVIA JADE’S RELATIONSHIP REVEALED 
 Deuxmoi was first to report that Olivia Jade Giannulli, the influencer and daughter of Lori Loughlin and Mossimo Giannulli, was dating Australian art dealer and entrepreneur PC Valmorbida. Now, new details are emerging about the relationship.
 Earlier this month, Deuxmoi received a tip alleging that Olivia Jade had been spotted grabbing coffee and kissing an unidentified man in New York City’s West Village on October 6. The eyewitness described the man as being in his late 40s or early 50s, with a distinguished, silver fox appearance.
 At the time, the man’s identity remained a mystery. However, a source subsequently identified him to Deuxmoi as PC Valmorbida, revealing that the two had also spent time together at Living Room in New York City. The identification came after an earlier sighting mistakenly linking Olivia to professional tennis player Taylor Fritz, who she was once allegedly dated.
 Since Deuxmoi’s initial reporting, Olivia Jade and Valmorbida have been photographed together by paparazzi in New York City, providing public confirmation of their relationship.
 Valmorbida, who is 40 years old, has also been the subject of speculation regarding a rumored past relationship with Mary-Kate Olsen. However, a source familiar with Valmorbida tells Deuxmoi that the two never dated and are simply friends.
